app_development.note: What porting a QML app to SailfishOS actually took. Source: the port of moWerk/asteroid-dodger (an AsteroidOS Qt6 game) to SailfishOS 5.1.0.11 on a Jolla C2, 2026-10-04, released as sfos-v2.0.0. Build setup: sdk_on_rootless_podman.json.
app_development.qt_version: CONFIRMED on the C2 (5.1.0.11): Qt 5.6.3, QtQuick 2.6, QtSensors, QtGraphicalEffects, QtMultimedia present; QtQuick.Shapes absent. Silica 1.2.154, libsailfishapp 1.2.17.
qt_5_6_gaps_hit: No QtQuick.Shapes: diamonds became Rectangles rotated by 45 degrees.

ES5 only. Hit in practice: String.padStart and Array.findIndex. let/const/arrow functions/template strings would also fail. Grep for the whole ES6 library, not a few names: a first grep with '.find(' missed '.findIndex('.
ShaderEffect takes inline GLSL strings; .qsb files are Qt 6.
An SVG using <use href> was not trusted to render; shipped as PNG.
Anchoring to an item that is not parent or sibling is dropped with a warning; the margin goes with it.
Qt.callLater() is Qt 5.8+: replaced by a 0 ms Timer with a queue of functions.
Math.sign() is not in Qt 5.6's JavaScript.

QtQuick.Shapes: static polygons -> Canvas painted once; terrain that follows a camera -> one Canvas with renderTarget FramebufferObject repainted on camera change. Costs CPU: a game with many Canvas items ran at 0.85 to 1.2 cores on the C2.
Qt 6 Connections handler syntax 'function onX() {...}' does not parse on Qt 5.6: use 'onX: {...}' (regex replace worked for 14 handlers in one app).
qmlRegisterSingletonType on Qt 5.6 needs a callback returning QObject *, not the concrete class pointer.
Qt 6 QAudioSink/QMediaDevices -> Qt 5 QAudioOutput/QAudioDeviceInfo with setSampleSize(16), SignedInt, LittleEndian, codec audio/pcm. Verified streaming on the C2.
A binding that falls back to itself (font.styleName: x ? x : font.styleName) is reported as a binding loop on Qt 5.6.
Animations with 'paused:' bound while not running produce 'setPaused() cannot be used when animation isn't running' warnings; bind paused: running && (...).

A QStringList returned by a Q_INVOKABLE arrives in QML JS as a sequence wrapper (JSON.stringify shows {"0":...}), not a plain array; copy it into a JS array before relying on indexOf/concat/JSON (CONFIRMED on the C2, heliograph 2026-10-06).
app_development.logging_trap: CONFIRMED: Qt on SailfishOS logs to the journal, not to stderr. Starting an app from ssh shows only libhybris 'library not found' lines and looks clean. Set QT_LOGGING_TO_CONSOLE=1 to see QML warnings. Three builds were declared clean by a blind check before this was noticed.
app_development.launch_from_ssh: As the user: sh -lc 'harbour-foo' gives the Wayland environment (WAYLAND_DISPLAY=../../display/wayland-0, XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/100000). The lipstick screenshot D-Bus call is refused for unprivileged callers.
app_development.project_skeleton: qmake with CONFIG += sailfishapp, TARGET harbour-<name>; qml/<target>.qml is the entry (Silica ApplicationWindow); rpm/<target>.spec with BuildRequires pkgconfig(sailfishapp), Qt5Core, Qt5Qml, Qt5Quick; <target>.desktop; icons/<size>/<target>.png for 86, 108, 128, 172. mb2 builds in tree and skips %prep.
app_development.haptics: ngfd has no 'press' event on SailfishOS; the short tick is 'feedback_press' (names in /usr/share/ngfd/events.d/feedback.ini).
app_development.fonts: A font the app asks for by family name has to be shipped and registered with QFontDatabase::addApplicationFont() before the view is created. Plain Text uses the system default, Sail Sans.
app_development.storage: QStandardPaths::AppConfigLocation with organization and application name set gives ~/.config/<org>/<app>/, the place a sandboxed app may write.
app_development.sandbox: Test builds: [X-Sailjail] Sandboxing=Disabled in the desktop file. Not acceptable for a store build.
app_development.cover: CONFIRMED on the C2: an Item tree can be reparented from the application window into an Item of the cover (ApplicationWindow.cover) and back, on applicationActive changes. The scene stays live in the cover, timers and the accelerometer keep running, so a game is playable in its home screen tile. CoverAction with image://theme/icon-cover-pause / icon-cover-play gives the tile a button.
app_development.icons: Jolla's 2018 icon template (CC BY 3.0) has 86 px SVGs; the Terminal icon is a square with rx about 1.4 of 86 and a radial gradient. The launcher caches icons: after replacing one, restart lipstick as the user (systemctl --user restart lipstick), which closes open apps.
app_development.screen_assumptions: A watch app tuned in pixels per frame is slower on a wider screen and a tall field holds more objects at once; fixed object pools and 'clear of every visible object' checks starve. The C2 has a camera notch: about 6 % of the width down from the top is hidden.
app_development.install_on_device: rpm -U --force <file> as root for a sideloaded test build; pkcon install-local for users. A fixed file name in an install script reinstalled an old build after a version bump: install the newest file and print rpm -q.
app_development.confidence: confirmed by doing on one device, four apps (2026-10-04/05)
app_development.selftest_screenshots: CONFIRMED 2026-10-05: QQuickWindow::grabWindow() from a QTimer in main.cpp (guarded by an env variable) saves a correct image of the app on the C2, but only while the display is on; with the display off it returns a white image. A face-down phone refuses unblank ('display ON request denied: proximity covered' in the mce journal); mcetool --set-ps-mode=disabled plus --set-inhibit-mode=stay-on works for testing, restore both afterwards.
app_development.sdk_container_zombies: CONFIRMED: a podman container whose PID 1 is 'sleep infinity' never reaps; each mb2 build leaves hundreds of zombies (sb2-monitor, sb2d, qemu) and the 2048 pids limit is hit after a few builds ('fork: Resource temporarily unavailable'). Restart the container (its writable layer with tooling and target survives) or start it with --init.
app_development.translations: qsTrId() with //% texts: CONFIG += sailfishapp_i18n sailfishapp_i18n_idbased runs lupdate+lrelease, but lrelease -nounfinished drops everything untranslated and the app shows raw ids. Add sailfishapp_i18n_unfinished so the default .qm carries the //% English.
app_development.sandbox_minimal: A game that only writes its own config dir runs sandboxed with [X-Sailjail] OrganizationName, ApplicationName, Permissions= (empty). Verified: sailjail -p <app>.desktop /usr/bin/<app> gives its own mount namespace and seccomp, QStandardPaths::AppConfigLocation is writable. Such a package passes rpmvalidation (only 'not stripped' warning). Nemo.Ngf (haptics) and an explicit libngf dependency fail the validator.
app_development.store_rules_harbour: CONFIRMED with rpmvalidation (5.1.0.11 tooling, allowed_*.conf under /srv/mer/toolings/<tooling>/usr/share/sdk-harbour-rpmvalidator/): allowed X-Sailjail permissions are Audio Bluetooth Camera Internet Location MediaIndexing Microphone NFC RemovableMedia UserDirs WebView Documents Downloads Music Pictures PublicDir Videos Compatibility Secrets Contacts Accounts; Sensors is NOT allowed. Measured: sandboxed without Sensors the QtSensors Accelerometer reports connectedToBackend=true but reads 0,0,0; with Sensors the first start asks the user once and readings are real. So tilt-controlled games cannot be Jolla Store apps. QtFeedback 5.0 is allowed only as ThemeEffect with Press/PressWeak/PressStrong; Nemo.Ngf and a libngf-qt5-declarative dependency are not allowed. qt5-qtdeclarative-import-sensors, qt5-qtgraphicaleffects, libkeepalive are allowed requires.
app_development.ngfd_events: SailfishOS ngfd has no 'press' or 'notif_strong' events (AsteroidOS names); NonGraphicalFeedback with them is silent. SailfishOS names: feedback_press etc. in /usr/share/ngfd/events.d/feedback.ini. A custom ngfd event needs a system file in /usr/share/ngfd/events.d and an ngfd restart; a SoundEffect from the app's files is simpler for an app.
app_development.display_settings: org.asteroid.settings DisplaySettings maps to 'import org.nemomobile.systemsettings 1.0' DisplaySettings (package nemo-qml-plugin-systemsettings): brightness, maximumBrightness. It writes the persistent brightness setting: an app that raises it and restores it in Component.onDestruction leaves it at maximum when killed. Works from inside the sandbox without extra permissions (tested 2026-10-05).
app_development.i18n_first_build: With sailfishapp_i18n the translations/ directory must exist before the first build, otherwise lupdate writes nothing and the app shows raw qsTrId ids; commit the generated .ts so a fresh clone builds the .qm.
app_development.tall_screen_porting: Watch games ported to a 720x1600 phone (2026-10-05): sizes in Dims.l() follow the width, which keeps proportions; speeds in px/frame need scaling (width/480); a world sized in screen pixels against fixed physics constants changes the game (touchdown: free fall 8.5 s -> 10.5 s) and should be sized from a fixed reference; cameras that fit a vertical span to the screen height zoom in on a tall screen and need a deliberate choice; HUD at the top needs about 6 % of the width clearance for the C2 notch.
app_development.audio_capture: CONFIRMED on the Jolla C2, 5.1.0.11, 2026-10-06: QAudioDeviceInfo::availableDevices(AudioInput) lists source.primary_input (microphone), sink.primary_output.monitor (what the phone plays), sink.fast.monitor, source.null, sink.null.monitor, all s16le 2ch 48 kHz. TRAP: Qt reports sink.primary_output.monitor as the DEFAULT input there, so 'default first' picks the speaker monitor, not the mic; order by name. QAudioInput opens both unjailed from ssh. Quiet-room mic RMS about 32 (int16 scale), idle monitor about 25. Sailjail: Microphone.permission just includes Audio.permission (comment: playback and record cannot be separated on pulseaudio); whether the jailed app may record the monitor is INFERRED from that, not tested. Used in beatfork 1.6.0.
app_development.camera_viewfinder: CONFIRMED 2026-10-06 from the C2's /usr/share/jolla-camera/camera.qml: the stock camera's VideoOutput sets only source (no orientation, no autoOrientation) in the native portrait window; camera.orientation (270 on the C2 back camera) is used only to map focus areas. So a portrait app shows the viewfinder with orientation 0. Qt-doc reasoning (90) and recalled Qt autoOrientation code (+270) were both wrong for gst-droid. With 0 the C2 reports a portrait sourceRect. QML Camera reaches ActiveStatus (8) even with the display blanked, launched from ssh. Picture itself not yet seen by a human. Used in horizon 1.1.0.
app_development.silent_screenshots: The C2 has no offscreen QPA plugin (platforms: hwcomposer, minimal, wayland-egl, wayland); minimal has no GL for Qt Quick, so window grabs need the real display on. Plan visual checks for when the owner is awake, especially for apps that raise brightness.
app_development.vendoring_c_libraries: aubio 0.4.9 compiled into an app via a qmake .pri (DEFINES HAVE_CONFIG_H, hand-written config.h, QMAKE_CFLAGS -std=c99, $$files() per subdir) builds on 5.1/4.5 aarch64, 4.5 i486 and 3.4 armv7hl targets. qmake puts all objects in one directory: check basenames are unique across subdirs. The C++-only flag -fvisibility-inlines-hidden gives a harmless cc1 warning per C file.
app_development.noarch_qml_apps: CONFIRMED 2026-10-06 on C2 5.1, Tablet 4.6 (i486), Jolla 1 3.4 (armv7hl): a pure QML app as one noarch RPM. Exec=sailfish-qml <name> (package libsailfishapp-launcher; NOT preinstalled on 3.4/4.6, Jolla repo has it, pkcon install-local pulls it); sailfishapp.prf has no QML-only mode, so .pro uses TEMPLATE = aux with INSTALLS for qml/, desktop, icons; sailfishapp_i18n still works in aux. Spec: BuildArch: noarch. TRAP: SDK 5.x compresses payloads with zstd; rpm 4.14.1 on 3.4 fails with 'cpio: Bad magic'; fix %define _binary_payload w6.xzdio. Storage without C++: Nemo.Configuration ConfigurationGroup (dconf, allowed by the store validator, sandbox Base permission grants the dconf writer); Qt.labs.settings is not installed on the C2. Fonts: FontLoader. QML cannot write files, so apps that write files keep C++. Validator reports 'Application is a QML-only app (sailfish-qml launcher)' as INFO. Tip from poetaster (forum t/34561).
app_development.harbour_sensors_via_camera: CONFIRMED 2026-10-06: /etc/sailjail/permissions/Camera.permission (and Location) include Sensors.permission (dbus talk com.nokia.SensorService). The store validator rejects Permissions=Sensors but accepts Camera, so a tilt app can pass with Permissions=Camera; the user is then asked for camera access. Live: blaster jailed with Permissions=Camera only reads the accelerometer. Compatibility.permission adds only private-bin tools (rpm, tar, busybox, ffmpeg...), nothing for sensors. Hint from poetaster (his harbour-spiritlevel uses Compatibility;Camera).
app_development.smooth_scrolling_text_animators: CONFIRMED 2026-10-17 (Heliograph 1.3.0, Jolla C2, SFOS 5.1): a banner moved by a JS Timer (16 ms, x -= v*dt) stuttered visibly, in the app and in the live cover. An XAnimator on the Label's x (render thread, vsync-paced) made it smooth ('butter smooth', author). Blink via OpacityAnimator in a SequentialAnimation. Animators write x back only when stopped, so to change speed mid-run compute the position from the start time (x0 - v*(now-t0)) and restart from there. SFOS apps run a threaded render loop (QSGRenderThread seen in lipstick; QSG_FIXED_ANIMATION_STEP=no in the environment). Silica Label reports renderType 0 (QtRendering, distance field) by default, so huge fixed-size text is cheap; the costly path is animating font.pixelSize (re-raster), see the author's benchymark SCALE vs RERASTER. Also: clip on a rotated item forces a stencil clip every frame; clip only where needed (unrotated preview).
app_development.qmllint_on_host: CONFIRMED 2026-10-17: noarch QML apps are not parsed by mb2 build, so syntax errors only show at runtime. /usr/bin/qmllint-qt5 on the build host checks syntax of SFOS QML files (Silica imports are not resolved, syntax only).
app_development.color_emoji_qt56: CONFIRMED 2026-10-17: SFOS 5.1 ships /usr/share/fonts/twemoji/TwitterColorEmoji-SVGinOT.ttf; Qt 5.6 cannot draw the SVG-in-OpenType table and shows the font's monochrome outline fallback. Coloured emoji in an app: ship Twemoji SVGs (CC-BY 4.0, github.com/jdecked/twemoji) and draw them as Image.
